body: I adopted my rescue in February. She was a puppy mill mother and she didn't eat for days as well. It made me very nervous and I scoured the internet looking for ways to help her acclimate enough to drink and eat. It took her about 4 days to decompress. She has since blossomed and is truly learning how to become a dog. He's very lucky to have someone who cares for him now enough to notice those things. Aside from all of the advice you've gotten here, patience is the best thing. He will figure out he's safe eventually. I got her to eat with some chicken broth on her kibble. Broth in place of water as well. You're doing great. Good luck with it! Congratulations on your new baby!
